highlights: Seasonal rides and games. Coastal location.

name: Majaland Gdansk
overview: A theme park based on the Studio 100 character 'Maya the Bee', featuring indoor and outdoor rides and attractions.
highlights: Maya the Bee theme. Indoor and outdoor rides. Family focus.

name: Hossoland
overview: A planned major new theme park development in the Western Pomerania region (under construction).
highlights: Planned major theme park (Future opening).

name: Pomerania Fun Park
overview: A large indoor and outdoor family amusement park featuring play areas, small rides, and games.
highlights: Indoor and outdoor play areas. Small rides and games.

name: Esplanada
overview: A mountain resort attraction featuring a seasonal toboggan run (Alpine slide) and other fun activities.
highlights: Summer toboggan run (Alpine slide). Mountain recreation.

name: Legendia (Silesian Amusement Park)
overview: The oldest and largest amusement park in Poland, featuring themed areas based on legends, fantasy, and a variety of rides.
highlights: Lech Coaster (launch coaster). Themed zones based on legends. Historic park.

name: Ogrodzieniec Park
overview: An adventure park located near Ogrodzieniec Castle, featuring activities like ropes courses, zip lines, and climbing.
highlights: Ropes courses and adventure activities. Located near a historic castle.

name: Aqualand
overview: A large water park complex featuring various slides, pools, and aquatic attractions.
highlights: Water slides and pools. Large aquatic park.

name: Aquashow
overview: A large water park and entertainment complex featuring slides, pools, and amusement rides (including a water coaster).
highlights: Water slides and pools. Water coaster and thrill rides.

name: Naturwaterpark
overview: A natural water park and recreational area offering camping, pools, and outdoor activities in a nature setting.
highlights: Natural park setting. Water slides and pools. Outdoor recreation.

name: Norpark
overview: A water park and leisure facility in the Nazaré area, featuring slides and pools.
highlights: Water slides and pools. Aquatic recreation.

name: Parque Aquático de Amarante
overview: A large water park complex featuring various slides, pools, and aquatic attractions.
highlights: Water slides and pools. Large aquatic park.

name: Parque Aquático no Complexo Desportivo do Príncipe Perfeito
overview: A water park located within the Príncipe Perfeito Sports Complex, featuring slides and pools.
highlights: Water slides and pools. Sports complex facilities.

name: Portugal dos Pequenitos
overview: A historic, miniature park featuring scaled-down replicas of traditional Portuguese houses and monuments, geared towards children.
highlights: Miniature replicas of Portuguese homes. Children's focus. Historic park.

name: Scorpio
overview: A local amusement or recreational center offering simple rides, games, or mini-golf.
highlights: Simple rides and games. Local family entertainment.

name: Slide & Splash
overview: One of the largest water parks in Portugal, featuring numerous thrilling water slides and aquatic attractions.
highlights: Numerous water slides and pools. Large aquatic park.

name: Zoomarine, Portugal
overview: A marine life park and theme park featuring dolphin shows, animal exhibits, and a variety of amusement rides and pools.
highlights: Dolphin and marine animal shows. Amusement rides and pools. Combination park.

name: Parc Aventura Brașov
overview: A large adventure park specializing in high ropes courses, zip lines, and outdoor challenges in a forest setting.
highlights: High ropes courses and zip lines. Outdoor adventure park.

name: Arsenal Park Transilvania
overview: A unique theme park and resort built on a former military arsenal, featuring military-themed exhibits, shows, and leisure activities.
highlights: Military theme and exhibits. Unique setting (former arsenal). Leisure resort.

name: Luna Parc
overview: A local amusement park or funfair in Pitești, featuring simple rides and games.
highlights: Simple rides and games. Local funfair atmosphere.

name: Orășelul Copiilor
overview: A children's town and amusement park, featuring various rides, playgrounds, and family entertainment.
highlights: Children's rides and play areas. Family entertainment.

name: Satul de Vacanță
overview: A vacation village and amusement area on the Black Sea coast, featuring carnival rides and dining.
highlights: Carnival rides and attractions. Black Sea resort location.

name: Alex & Emma's Land
overview: A local children's play area or small amusement park.
highlights: Children's play area. Simple amusements.

name: Beoland
overview: A local amusement or fun park in Nizhny Novgorod, featuring rides and entertainment.
highlights: Amusement rides and entertainment.

name: Rivyera
overview: A large resort complex featuring a prominent aquapark (Riviera Aquapark) and a hotel.
highlights: Riviera Aquapark (large water park). Resort and hotel facilities.

name: Admiral Vrungel
overview: A local amusement or fun park in the Black Sea resort town of Gelendzhik.
highlights: Seaside amusement rides. Local entertainment.

name: Krasnodar Park
overview: A modern and highly landscaped public park that may include recreational or amusement features.
highlights: Modern public park. Landscaped grounds.

name: Sochi Park
overview: Russia's first major theme park, themed around Russian folklore and fairy tales, featuring modern roller coasters and attractions.
highlights: Quantum Leap (inverted coaster) and other thrill rides. Russian folklore theme. Located in the Olympic Park.

name: Attractionmania
overview: A local amusement or fun park in Moscow, featuring rides and entertainment.
highlights: Amusement rides and entertainment.

name: Gorky Park, Moscow
overview: A major cultural and recreation park in Moscow, featuring green spaces, recreational facilities, and a small amusement area (historically contained a large one).
highlights: Major urban park. Recreational activities and events.

name: Sokolniki Park
overview: A large park in Moscow featuring gardens, exhibitions, and recreational areas, including a small amusement zone.
highlights: Public park and recreation. Small amusement attractions.

name: Star Galaxy Adventure
overview: A themed indoor or outdoor amusement area focusing on space or galaxy themes.
highlights: Space or galaxy theme. Amusement attractions.

name: Dream Island
overview: The largest indoor theme park in Europe, featuring themed zones based on various cartoon and film franchises.
highlights: Largest indoor theme park in Europe. Cartoon and film franchise themes. Modern rides.

name: Gagarin Park
overview: A public park in Saint Petersburg that includes an amusement area with rides and games.
highlights: Amusement rides and attractions. Public park setting.

name: Park Alisa
overview: A local amusement or fun park in Saint Petersburg.
highlights: Amusement rides and entertainment.

name: Park Yulya
overview: A local amusement or fun park in Saint Petersburg.
highlights: Amusement rides and entertainment.

name: Wonder Island
overview: A major amusement park located on an island in Saint Petersburg, featuring roller coasters and thrill rides.
highlights: Roller coasters and thrill rides. Located on Krestovsky Island.

name: DinoPark
overview: A dinosaur-themed park featuring life-size models, a 3D cinema, and paleontological exhibits.
highlights: Life-size dinosaur models. 3D cinema. Dinosaur exhibits.

name: Tatrapolis Svet Miniatúr
overview: A miniature park featuring scaled-down replicas of Slovak landmarks and possibly small amusement rides.
highlights: Miniature replicas of Slovak landmarks. Small amusement attractions.

name: Adventure Park Postojna
overview: An adventure park located near the Postojna Caves, featuring ropes courses, zip lines, and outdoor challenges.
highlights: Ropes courses and zip lines. Outdoor adventure activities. Near Postojna Caves.

name: Isla Mágica
overview: A theme park set on the former Expo '92 grounds, themed around the discovery of America, featuring thrill rides and the Agua Mágica water park.
highlights: Discovery of America theme. El Jaguar inverted coaster. Agua Mágica water park.

name: Tivoli World
overview: A former classic amusement park on the Costa del Sol (currently closed and awaiting redevelopment).
highlights: Former classic amusement park (Closed).

name: Dinópolis
overview: A science and theme park complex focused on paleontology and dinosaurs, featuring a museum, exhibits, and small rides.
highlights: Paleontology museum and exhibits. Dinosaur theme. Small rides and shows.

name: Parque de Atracciones de Zaragoza
overview: A traditional amusement park in Zaragoza featuring a mix of modern and classic rides, including roller coasters.
highlights: Roller coasters and thrill rides. Classic amusement park atmosphere.

name: Parque de Atracciones Monte Igueldo
overview: A historic, charming amusement park located atop Mount Igueldo, accessible by funicular, featuring antique rides and scenic views.
highlights: Historic amusement park. Scenic funicular access. Views over San Sebastián.

name: Puy du Fou España
overview: A historical theme park based on the Spanish version of Puy du Fou, featuring spectacular live shows and historical reenactments of Spanish history.
highlights: Spectacular historical live shows. Focus on Spanish history and culture. Immersive experiences.

name: Ferrari Land
overview: A Ferrari-themed park featuring the tallest and fastest vertical accelerator coaster in Europe (Red Force) and racing simulators.
highlights: Red Force (Europe's tallest and fastest). Ferrari theme and simulators. Located near PortAventura Park.

name: PortAventura Park
overview: One of Europe's premier theme park resorts, featuring multiple themed areas (Mediterrània, Far West, etc.) and world-class roller coasters.
highlights: Shambhala (hypercoaster) and Furius Baco (launch coaster). Six themed zones. Integrated resort complex.

name: Tibidabo Amusement Park
overview: A charming, historic amusement park located on Tibidabo mountain, featuring classic rides, a large Ferris wheel, and stunning views of Barcelona.
highlights: Historic classic rides. Great views of Barcelona. Mountain-top location.

name: Parque de Atracciones de Madrid
overview: A major amusement park in Madrid's Casa de Campo park, featuring thrill rides, roller coasters, and a children's area.
highlights: Abismo and Tifón coasters. Mix of thrill and family rides. Located in a large public park.

name: Parque Warner Madrid
city: San Martín de la Vega, Community of Madrid
overview: A theme park based on Warner Bros. movies and DC Comics characters, featuring major roller coasters and immersive themed zones.
highlights: Superman: La Atracción de Acero (floorless coaster). DC Comics and Hollywood themes. Thrill rides.

name: Sendaviva
overview: A nature and adventure park combining a safari, amusement rides, and adventure activities in a natural environment.
highlights: Safari and animal exhibits. Adventure rides and zip lines. Nature park setting.

name: DinoPark Algar
overview: A dinosaur-themed park featuring life-size models, 3D cinema, and simple play areas.
highlights: Life-size dinosaur models. 3D cinema. Play areas.

name: Pola Park
overview: A family amusement park featuring a mix of simple rides, mini-golf, and family attractions.
highlights: Simple rides and games. Mini-golf and family attractions.

name: Terra Mítica
overview: A large theme park themed around ancient Mediterranean civilizations (Egypt, Greece, Rome), featuring thrill rides and immersive shows.
highlights: Ancient Mediterranean theme. Titans and Magnus Colossus (historic wooden coaster) rides. Thrill rides and shows.

name: Astrid Lindgren's World
overview: A theme park based on the children's books of Swedish author Astrid Lindgren (Pippi Longstocking, Emil), featuring interactive environments and live theatre.
highlights: Live performances based on Pippi Longstocking. Highly interactive themed environments. Focus on children's literature.

name: Furuviksparken
overview: A seaside park combining an amusement park, a zoo, and a concert venue.
highlights: Wilderness theme and zoo exhibits. Roller coasters and thrill rides. Concert venue.

name: Gröna Lund
overview: A historic, compact amusement park known for its dense collection of vertical rides and stunning seaside location in central Stockholm.
highlights: Insane (4D roller coaster) and other thrill rides. Compact, urban setting. Historic atmosphere.

name: High Chaparral Theme Park
overview: A Western-themed amusement park featuring stunt shows, train robberies, and themed entertainment.
highlights: Wild West theme and stunt shows. Train ride and themed villages.

name: Kneippbyn
overview: A family resort and amusement park featuring a large water park and the original house used in the Pippi Longstocking films.
highlights: Pippi Longstocking's house (Villa Villekulla). Large water park. Resort amenities.

name: Kolmården Wildlife Park
overview: One of the largest wildlife parks in the world, featuring animal exhibits, a dolphinarium, and the Wildfire wooden coaster.
highlights: Wildfire (world-class wooden coaster). Safari and dolphin shows. Large zoo and wildlife exhibits.

name: Öland Zoo
overview: A large park combining a zoo, an aquarium, and a small amusement ride area.
highlights: Zoo and aquarium exhibits. Small amusement rides. Located on Öland island.

name: Parken Zoo
overview: A combination zoo and amusement park, focusing on rare animal breeds and featuring simple rides.
highlights: Zoo and conservation focus. Small amusement rides.

name: Skara Sommarland
overview: A large summer park featuring a major water park, amusement rides, and a go-kart track.
highlights: Large water park section. Roller coasters and thrill rides. Go-karts.

name: Santaworld
overview: A Christmas-themed park focused on Santa Claus, elves, and holiday activities.
highlights: Santa Claus and Christmas themes. Holiday-themed activities.

name: Tosselilla Summer Park
overview: A family summer park featuring a water park, amusement rides, and a small zoo/animal section.
highlights: Water park and amusement rides. Small animal exhibits. Family entertainment.

name: Connyland
overview: A major amusement park featuring a mix of thrill rides, roller coasters, and marine animal shows (sea lions).
highlights: Cobra inverted coaster. Sea lion shows. Roller coasters and thrill rides.

name: Jungfrau Park
overview: A theme park based on global mysteries and phenomena (formerly Mystery Park), featuring multimedia shows and exhibits.
highlights: Themed multimedia shows (mysteries). Exhibits on global phenomena. Scenic location.

name: Swiss Vapeur Parc
overview: A miniature park dedicated to model steam trains, featuring an extensive network of tracks and miniature train rides.
highlights: Miniature steam train rides. Extensive track network. Focus on model trains.

name: Vialand
overview: A large theme park and shopping complex (now Isfanbul), featuring roller coasters, thrill rides, and an entertainment center.
highlights: Nefeskesen (launch coaster). Shopping and entertainment complex. Large park size.

name: Masal Park
overview: A fairy tale-themed park (Masal means 'fairy tale') featuring themed exhibits, play areas, and simple rides.
highlights: Fairy tale theme and exhibits. Simple rides and play areas.

name: Mazakaland
overview: A large park complex featuring amusement rides, a zoo, and various family attractions.
highlights: Amusement rides and zoo. Large family entertainment complex.

name: Parkantep Harikalar Diyarı
overview: A large public park and amusement area (Harikalar Diyarı means 'Wonderland') featuring rides and recreational facilities.
highlights: Amusement rides and attractions. Large public park.

name: Wonderland Eurasia
overview: A massive theme park and entertainment complex featuring a large collection of roller coasters and themed zones (currently closed).
highlights: Large collection of roller coasters (Historical). Huge park size (Closed).

name: The Land of Legends
overview: A major resort and theme park complex featuring a large water park (Theme Park and Aqua Park) and high-tech attractions.
highlights: Hyper Coaster and Typhoon water coaster. Large water park. Luxury resort amenities.

name: Ancient Kyiv, Principality of Kyivan Rus
overview: A historical and cultural park recreating the medieval city of Kyiv (Kyivan Rus), featuring historical reenactments, shows, and cultural activities.
highlights: Recreation of medieval Kyiv. Historical reenactments and shows. Cultural focus.

name: Legoland Windsor Resort
overview: A Legoland park based on the popular Lego toy brand, featuring rides, Miniland displays, and themed accommodation.
highlights: Miniland (UK landmarks). Family-friendly rides. Lego-themed resort.

name: Mount Everest
overview: Earth's highest mountain above sea level, located in the Mahalangur Himal sub-range of the Himalayas. The international border between Nepal and China runs across its summit point.
highlights:
Standing at the highest point on Earth.
The challenging trek to Base Camp and through the Khumbu Icefall.
Breathtaking views of neighboring peaks like Lhotse and Nuptse.

name: K2
overview: The second-highest mountain on Earth, known as the 'Savage Mountain' due to the extreme difficulty of ascent. It is located in the Karakoram range.
highlights:
Notorious for its steep pyramid shape and unpredictable weather.
The Bottle Neck remains one of the most dangerous climbing passages in the world.
Offers spectacular views of the Karakoram glaciers.

name: Kangchenjunga
overview: The third highest mountain in the world. Its name translates to 'The Five Treasures of Snow', referring to its five distinct peaks.
highlights:
Sacred to the people of Sikkim, climbers often stop short of the actual summit out of respect.
Dominates the view from Darjeeling hill station.
Known for its massive and complex massif structure.

name: Lhotse
overview: The fourth highest mountain on Earth, connected to Everest via the South Col. Its steep south face is one of the most impressive walls in the Himalayas.
highlights:
Often climbed in conjunction with an Everest expedition.
The Lhotse Face is a steep wall of glacial blue ice.
Offers incredible proximity views of Everest.

name: Makalu
overview: The fifth highest mountain in the world, located 19 km southeast of Everest. It is an isolated peak shaped like a four-sided pyramid.
highlights:
Considered one of the most difficult eight-thousanders to climb due to steep pitches and knife-edged ridges.
Located in the Makalu Barun National Park.
Known for its distinct, sharp summit structure.

name: Cho Oyu
overview: The sixth highest mountain in the world. It is generally considered the easiest eight-thousander to climb due to its moderate slopes.
highlights:
A popular first 8,000-meter peak for mountaineers.
The name means 'Turquoise Goddess' in Tibetan.
Offers massive panoramic views of the Everest region.

name: Dhaulagiri
overview: The seventh highest mountain in the world. It forms the eastern limit of the Kaligandaki River gorge, the deepest gorge in the world.
highlights:
Its name means 'White Mountain'.
Separated from Annapurna by the Kaligandaki Gorge.
Known for its massive, glittering south face.

name: Manaslu
overview: The eighth highest mountain in the world, located in the Mansiri Himal. Its name is derived from the Sanskrit word for 'intellect' or 'soul'.
highlights:
Known as the 'Mountain of the Spirit'.
The Manaslu Circuit Trek is a famous alternative to the Annapurna Circuit.
Features a distinctively sharp, double-headed summit.

name: Nanga Parbat
overview: The ninth highest mountain in the world. Known as the 'Killer Mountain' due to the high number of fatalities during early climbing attempts.
highlights:
The Rupal Face is the highest vertical mountain face in the world.
It marks the western anchor of the Himalayas.
Surrounded by lush green alpine meadows at its base.

name: Annapurna
overview: The tenth highest mountain in the world and historically one of the most dangerous to climb due to high avalanche risk.
highlights:
The first 8,000-meter peak ever to be climbed (1950).
The Annapurna Sanctuary trek leads directly into the heart of the massif.
Famous for its massive south face.

name: Gasherbrum I
overview: Also known as Hidden Peak, it is the 11th highest mountain in the world, located in the Karakoram range.
highlights:
Part of the remote Gasherbrum massif.
Often climbed in combination with Gasherbrum II.
Offers a true wilderness climbing experience.

name: Broad Peak
overview: The 12th highest mountain in the world, located in the Karakoram range just a few kilometers from K2.
highlights:
Named for its unusually long summit ridge (over 1.5 km).
Offers one of the best viewpoints for observing K2.
Known locally as Falchan Kangri.

name: Gasherbrum II
overview: The 13th highest mountain in the world. It is considered one of the safest and most accessible 8,000-meter peaks.
highlights:
Features a spectacular pyramid shape.
Often used as a preparation peak for K2.
Located at the head of the Baltoro Glacier.

name: Gasherbrum IV
overview: Although not an 8,000er, strictly speaking, it is the 17th highest mountain and famous for its sheer West Face, the 'Shining Wall'.
highlights:
Renowned for its incredible technical difficulty.
The Shining Wall is one of the most celebrated challenges in alpinism.
Dominates the view at the junction of the Baltoro glacier.

name: Masherbrum
overview: Originally designated K1 (the first peak of the Karakoram), it is a stunning peak known for its steepness and difficulty.
highlights:
Often called the 'Queen of Peaks' for its beauty.
Extremely difficult to climb, with few successful summits.
Located south of the Baltoro Glacier.

name: Shishapangma
overview: The 14th highest mountain in the world and the only eight-thousander located entirely within Chinese territory (Tibet).
highlights:
The name means 'Crest above the Grassy Plains'.
Considered one of the more accessible 8,000m peaks.
Offers expansive views of the Tibetan Plateau.

name: Nanda Devi
overview: The second highest mountain in India. The name means 'Bliss-Giving Goddess' and the peak is held sacred.
highlights:
Surrounded by the Nanda Devi Sanctuary, a protected biosphere.
Known for its treacherous terrain and beauty.
Currently closed to climbers to protect the fragile ecosystem.

name: Rakaposhi
overview: A mountain in the Karakoram range known for its exceptional rise over local terrain, towering dramatically over the Hunza Valley.
highlights:
Features one of the longest uninterrupted vertical rises on Earth.
Visible directly from the Karakoram Highway.
Famous for its vast, snow-covered walls.

name: Tirich Mir
overview: The highest mountain in the Hindu Kush range. Its name may mean 'King of Darkness' or 'King of Tirich'.
highlights:
Highest peak outside the Himalayas and Karakoram.
Overlooks the town of Chitral.
Known for its formidable glaciers and deep crevasses.

name: Mount Kilimanjaro
overview: A dormant volcano and the highest mountain in Africa. It is the highest single free-standing mountain in the world.
highlights:
One of the 'Seven Summits'.
Climbers pass through five distinct ecological zones.
Famous for its shrinking ice cap on the summit crater, Kibo.

name: Mount Kenya
overview: The second highest mountain in Africa. It is an extinct stratovolcano with rugged peaks and equatorial glaciers.
highlights:
Features technical climbing on its highest twin peaks, Batian and Nelion.
Home to unique high-altitude afro-alpine flora.
Offers trekking access to Point Lenana for hikers.

name: Mount Stanley
overview: The highest mountain in the Rwenzori range (Mountains of the Moon) and the third highest in Africa.
highlights:
Known for its permanent equatorial mist and glaciers.
Home to bizarre giant lobelias and groundels.
Offers a mystical, challenging trek through boggy terrain.

name: Mount Elgon
overview: An extinct shield volcano on the border of Uganda and Kenya. It has one of the largest intact calderas in the world.
highlights:
Famous for its 'salt-mining elephants' in Kitum Cave.
Features immense caves and waterfalls.
Offers trekking without technical climbing skills.

name: Mount Meru
overview: An active stratovolcano located 70 kilometers west of Mount Kilimanjaro. It is often climbed for acclimatization before Kilimanjaro.
highlights:
Offers stunning views of Kilimanjaro from the summit.
The crater rim walk provides a dramatic drop-off view.
Rich in wildlife on the lower slopes.

name: Ras Dashen
overview: The highest mountain in Ethiopia, located in the Simien Mountains National Park.
highlights:
Home to the endemic Gelada baboons and Walia ibex.
Features dramatic escarpments and jagged peaks.
The landscape is often described as the 'Chessboard of God'.

name: Mount Toubkal
overview: The highest peak in the Atlas Mountains and North Africa. It is a popular trekking destination in Morocco.
highlights:
Accessible non-technical climb with rewarding views.
Summit offers views of the Sahara Desert on clear days.
Located just south of Marrakech.

name: Table Mountain
overview: A flat-topped mountain forming a prominent landmark overlooking the city of Cape Town.
highlights:
Famous for the 'Tablecloth' cloud formation.
Accessible by cable car or hiking trails.
Home to rich biodiversity, including fynbos vegetation.

name: Lion's Head
overview: A distinctively shaped mountain in Cape Town, located next to Table Mountain and Signal Hill.
highlights:
Offers 360-degree panoramic views of the city and ocean.
Popular for full-moon hikes.
Known for its sphinx-like appearance.

name: Mount Nyiragongo
overview: An active stratovolcano in the Virunga Mountains, famous for housing the world's largest fluid lava lake.
highlights:
The summit offers a mesmerizing view of the bubbling lava lake.
Known for its unusually fast-flowing lava.
A challenging trek in a volatile volcanic region.

name: Mount Catherine
overview: The highest mountain in Egypt, located near the city of Saint Catherine in the Sinai Peninsula.
highlights:
Offers panoramic views over the Sinai mountains and Red Sea.
Located near the historic Saint Catherine's Monastery.
A rewarding hike often done in conjunction with Mount Sinai.

name: Mount Sinai
overview: A mountain in the Sinai Peninsula of Egypt that is a possible location of the biblical Mount Sinai.
highlights:
Religiously significant as the place where Moses received the Ten Commandments.
Popular for sunrise hikes and the 'Steps of Repentance'.
Features a chapel and mosque at the summit.

name: Mont Blanc
overview: The highest mountain in the Alps and Western Europe. Its name means 'White Mountain'.
highlights:
Considered the birthplace of modern mountaineering.
The stunning views stretch across French, Italian, and Swiss Alps.
A major objective for alpinists worldwide.

name: Grandes Jorasses
overview: A mountain in the Mont Blanc massif, famous for its impressive North Face.
highlights:
Its North Face is one of the six great north faces of the Alps.
A legendary challenge for technical climbers.
Defining feature of the Chamonix valley skyline.

name: La Meije
overview: A prominent mountain in the Massif des Écrins. It was the last major peak in the Alps to be climbed.
highlights:
Known for its difficult and jagged ridges.
Offers spectacular views of the Écrins National Park.
A symbol of hardcore alpinism in France.

name: Matterhorn
overview: A mountain of the Alps, straddling the border between Switzerland and Italy. It is one of the most iconic mountains in the world due to its pyramid shape.
highlights:
The nearly symmetrical peak is a defining symbol of Switzerland.
Famous for the tragic first ascent in 1865.
Dominates the view from the town of Zermatt.

name: Dufourspitze
overview: The highest peak of Monte Rosa, making it the highest mountain in Switzerland.
highlights:
A massive glaciated massif with multiple summits.
Offers challenging high-altitude mountaineering routes.
Located on the Swiss-Italian border.

name: Dom
overview: A mountain in the Pennine Alps. It is the highest mountain located entirely within Switzerland.
highlights:
Part of the Mischabel massif.
Known for its long vertical ascent from the valley floor.
Offers a classic snow and ice climb.

name: Weisshorn
overview: A major peak in the Pennine Alps, often considered the most beautiful mountain in the Alps due to its perfect pyramid shape.
highlights:
More difficult to climb than the Matterhorn.
Features three distinct ridges for ascent.
A masterpiece of natural alpine architecture.

name: Eiger
overview: A mountain in the Bernese Alps, famous for its daunting North Face (Nordwand), the biggest north face in the Alps.
highlights:
The North Face is nicknamed the 'Murder Wall'.
Visible from the Jungfraujoch railway.
A legendary site for extreme mountaineering history.

name: Jungfrau
overview: One of the main summits of the Bernese Alps. Its name means 'Maiden' or 'Virgin'.
highlights:
Home to the Jungfraujoch, the highest railway station in Europe.
Part of the UNESCO World Heritage Jungfrau-Aletsch area.
Offers accessible glacier views for tourists.

name: Piz Bernina
overview: The highest mountain in the Eastern Alps and the Bernina Range.
highlights:
Features the famous Biancograt ridge, a knife-edge snow ridge.
The most easterly 4,000-meter peak in the Alps.
Dominates the Engadin valley landscape.

name: Gran Paradiso
overview: A mountain in the Graian Alps, the highest mountain entirely within Italy.
highlights:
Located in the Gran Paradiso National Park.
Often climbed as a first 4,000-meter peak.
The summit features a statue of the Madonna.

name: Mount Etna
overview: An active stratovolcano on the east coast of Sicily. It is the highest active volcano in Europe.
highlights:
Frequent eruptions create a constantly changing landscape.
Rich in mythology as the forge of Hephaestus.
Offers skiing in winter and hiking on lava fields.

name: Mount Vesuvius
overview: A somma-stratovolcano located on the Gulf of Naples, best known for its eruption in AD 79 that destroyed Pompeii.
highlights:
The only active volcano on the European mainland.
Visitors can hike to the crater rim and see steam vents.
Offers a commanding view of the Bay of Naples.

name: Stromboli
overview: A small island in the Tyrrhenian Sea containing one of the most active volcanoes on Earth.
highlights:
Known as the 'Lighthouse of the Mediterranean' for its glow.
Features almost continuous mild explosive activity.
Night treks offer views of lava fountains.

name: Dolomites
overview: A mountain range in the northern Italian Alps, recognized as a UNESCO World Heritage site for its unique limestone formations and scenic beauty.
highlights:
Includes the iconic Tre Cime di Lavaredo and Marmolada, the 'Queen of the Dolomites'.
Famous for the largest glacier in the region and historical WWI tunnels.
A premier destination for world-class hiking, skiing, and rock climbing.

name: Zugspitze
overview: The highest peak of the Wetterstein Mountains and the highest mountain in Germany.
highlights:
Offers panoramic views into four countries.
Accessible by cable car and cogwheel train.
Features a glacier ski resort on the Zugspitzplatt.

name: Watzmann
overview: A mountain in the Berchtesgaden Alps, famous for its distinct shape resembling a family (Watzmann, Wife, and Children).
highlights:
The East Face is the highest vertical rock face in the Eastern Alps.
Central to local folklore and legends.
Dominates the view above Lake Königssee.

name: Grossglockner
overview: The highest mountain in Austria and the highest mountain in the Alps east of the Brenner Pass.
highlights:
Located in the Hohe Tauern National Park.
Accessible via the scenic Grossglockner High Alpine Road.
Features the Pasterze, Austria's longest glacier.

name: Grossvenediger
overview: The main peak of the Venediger Group in the Hohe Tauern. It is Austria's fourth highest mountain.
highlights:
Known as the 'world's oldest majesty' locally.
A popular glacier climb offering vast views.
The name might refer to visibility all the way to Venice.

name: Hoher Dachstein
overview: A strongly karstic Austrian mountain, and the highest peak in the Northern Limestone Alps.
highlights:
Famous for the Dachstein Glacier and Skywalk.
The south face is a classic climbing destination.
Features the 'Stairway to Nothingness' viewing platform.

name: Triglav
overview: The highest mountain in Slovenia and the highest peak of the Julian Alps.
highlights:
A pre-eminent symbol of the Slovene nation, featured on the flag.
Climbing it is considered a rite of passage for Slovenes.
Features the Aljaž Tower at the summit.

name: Mount Elbrus
overview: A dormant volcano in the Caucasus Mountains. It is the highest mountain in Europe.
highlights:
One of the 'Seven Summits'.
Features twin summits, both volcanic domes.
Offers skiing on its slopes and expansive views of the Caucasus.

name: Mount Kazbek
overview: A dormant stratovolcano and one of the major mountains of the Caucasus. It is associated with the myth of Prometheus.
highlights:
Famous for the Gergeti Trinity Church located at its base.
A challenging but popular mountaineering destination.
Offers stunning scenery of the Georgian military road.

name: Mount Ararat
overview: A snow-capped and dormant compound volcano in eastern Turkey. It is the highest peak in Turkey.
highlights:
Traditionally considered the resting place of Noah's Ark.
Dominates the Armenian Highland landscape.
Has two distinct peaks, Greater and Lesser Ararat.

name: Mount Olympus
overview: The highest mountain in Greece. In Greek mythology, it was the home of the Twelve Olympian gods.
highlights:
Rich in biodiversity and mythological history.
The highest peak is called Mytikas.
Designated as a National Park and World Biosphere Reserve.

name: Mount Athos
overview: A mountain and peninsula in northeastern Greece. It is an autonomous monastic state and a major center of Eastern Orthodox monasticism.
highlights:
Known as the 'Holy Mountain'.
Access is restricted and requires a special permit.
Home to 20 ancient monasteries clinging to its cliffs.

name: Musala
overview: The highest peak in the Rila Mountains, as well as in Bulgaria and the entire Balkan Peninsula.
highlights:
The name implies 'Near God' or 'Place for Prayer'.
Offers a clear view of all major mountain ranges in Bulgaria.
Accessible via hike from the Borovets resort.

name: Gerlachovsky stit
overview: The highest peak in the High Tatras, Slovakia, and the whole 1,500 km long Carpathian mountain chain.
highlights:
Requires a certified mountain guide for the ascent.
Features a dramatic alpine landscape with glacial lakes.
Offers vast views over Slovakia and Poland.

name: Rysy
overview: A mountain in the crest of the High Tatras, lying on the border between Poland and Slovakia. It is the highest point in Poland.
highlights:
Has three summits, the highest is in Slovakia.
A very popular hiking destination in the Tatras.
Offers beautiful views of the Morskie Oko lake.

name: Mulhacen
overview: The highest mountain in mainland Spain and the Iberian Peninsula, located in the Sierra Nevada range.
highlights:
Offers views of the Mediterranean Sea and sometimes Africa.
Relatively gentle slopes on the south side.
Named after Muley Hacen, a 15th-century King of Granada.

name: Aneto
overview: The highest mountain in the Pyrenees and in Aragon, and Spain's third-highest mountain.
highlights:
Features the largest glacier in the Pyrenees (though shrinking).
Climbers must cross the dangerous 'Bridge of Mohammed' ridge.
Offers iconic views of the Pyrenean chain.

name: Monte Perdido
overview: The third highest mountain in the Pyrenees. Its name means 'Lost Mountain'.
highlights:
Located in the Ordesa y Monte Perdido National Park.
A massive limestone peak with a distinct stepped profile.
Part of a UNESCO World Heritage site.

name: Torre de Cerredo
overview: The highest peak in the Picos de Europa range and the Cantabrian Mountains.
highlights:
A rugged limestone peak offering spectacular views.
Requires technical scrambling to reach the summit.
Surrounded by deep chasms and steep cliffs.

name: Mount Teide
overview: A volcano on Tenerife in the Canary Islands. It is the highest point in Spain and the highest point above the islands of the Atlantic.
highlights:
The third highest volcano in the world from its base.
Located in Teide National Park, a UNESCO site.
Casts the world's largest sea shadow.

name: Montserrat
overview: A multi-peaked mountain range near Barcelona. Its name means 'Serrated Mountain' due to its jagged peaks.
highlights:
Home to the famous Benedictine abbey, Santa Maria de Montserrat.
Known for its unique pink conglomerate rock formations.
A major pilgrimage site and climbing destination.

name: Galdhopiggen
overview: The highest mountain in Norway, Scandinavia, and Northern Europe.
highlights:
Located in Jotunheimen National Park.
Accessible via glacier crossing or rocky trails.
Offers a stunning panorama of the surrounding peaks.

name: Stetind
overview: A mountain in Nordland county, voted Norway's National Mountain. It is famous for its smooth, anvil-like shape.
highlights:
A classic destination for rock climbers.
Rises vertically directly from the fjord.
Known for the 'Mysosten' block feature.

name: Kebnekaise
overview: The highest mountain in Sweden. It has two main peaks, the southern glaciated one and the northern rocky one.
highlights:
Located in Lapland, north of the Arctic Circle.
The height varies due to the melting glacier on the south peak.
Part of the famous Kungsleden hiking trail.

name: Ben Nevis
overview: The highest mountain in the British Isles, located in the Scottish Highlands.
highlights:
The summit features the ruins of an old observatory.
The North Face is famous for ice climbing.
Often shrouded in mist and cloud.

name: Scafell Pike
overview: The highest mountain in England, located in the Lake District National Park.
highlights:
Part of the National Three Peaks Challenge.
Known for its rocky summit and expansive views.
Surrounded by other high fells and lakes.

name: Snowdon
overview: The highest mountain in Wales, located in Snowdonia National Park. Known locally as Yr Wyddfa.
highlights:
Accessible by the Snowdon Mountain Railway.
Features several ridges including the razor-sharp Crib Goch.
Offers views across to Ireland on clear days.

name: Kirkjufell
overview: A distinctively shaped peak on the north coast of Iceland's Snæfellsnes Peninsula.
highlights:
Known as the 'Arrowhead Mountain' from Game of Thrones.
Often photographed with the Kirkjufellsfoss waterfall.
One of the most photographed mountains in Iceland.

name: Snaefellsjokull
overview: A stratovolcano with a glacier covering its summit. It is the setting for Jules Verne's 'Journey to the Center of the Earth'.
highlights:
Dominates the Snæfellsnes Peninsula.
Regarded as one of the world's energy centers by New Age believers.
Visible from Reykjavík on clear days.

name: Hekla
overview: An active stratovolcano in south Iceland. It was historically known as the 'Gateway to Hell'.
highlights:
One of Iceland's most active volcanoes.
The ridge resembles an overturned boat.
Hiking offers views of the blackened lava fields.

name: Eyjafjallajökull
overview: A volcano completely covered by an ice cap. It became famous worldwide for its 2010 eruption that disrupted air travel.
highlights:
The name means 'Island Mountain Glacier'.
Offers a dramatic contrast between fire and ice.
Visible from the famous Skógafoss waterfall.

name: Denali
overview: The highest mountain peak in North America, located in the Alaska Range. Formerly known as Mount McKinley.
highlights:
One of the 'Seven Summits'.
Famous for its massive vertical relief and extreme cold.
Centerpiece of Denali National Park.

name: Mount Logan
overview: The highest mountain in Canada and the second-highest in North America.
highlights:
Has the largest base circumference of any non-volcanic mountain on Earth.
Located in Kluane National Park.
Extremely remote and subject to severe weather.

name: Mount Saint Elias
overview: The second-highest mountain in both Canada and the United States, located on the Yukon-Alaska border.
highlights:
Notable for its immense vertical rise directly from Icy Bay.
First ascended by the Duke of the Abruzzi in 1897.
Subject of the documentary 'Mount St. Elias'.

name: Mount Fairweather
overview: One of the world's highest coastal mountains, located on the border between Alaska and British Columbia.
highlights:
Named by Captain James Cook for the good weather encountered.
Visible from the sea, rising dramatically from the coast.
Known for harsh weather despite its name.

name: Mount Waddington
overview: The highest peak in the Coast Mountains of British Columbia, known as 'Mystery Mountain'.
highlights:
Extremely remote and difficult to access.
Surrounded by massive glaciers.
Offers a greater technical challenge than many higher peaks.

name: Mount Robson
overview: The highest mountain in the Canadian Rockies. It is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
highlights:
The 'Emperor Face' is one of the most famous big walls in North America.
Berg Lake at its base is a world-renowned hiking destination.
Often shrouded in clouds due to its prominence.

name: Mount Assiniboine
overview: Known as the 'Matterhorn of the Rockies' due to its striking pyramidal shape.
highlights:
Located on the Great Divide between British Columbia and Alberta.
Reflects beautifully in Lake Magog.
Accessible only by hiking or helicopter.

name: Mount Columbia
overview: The second highest mountain in the Canadian Rockies and the highest in Alberta.
highlights:
Located on the edge of the Columbia Icefield.
Climbed mostly as a ski mountaineering objective.
Offers a vast view of the surrounding icefields.

name: Mount Thor
overview: A mountain in Auyuittuq National Park, famous for having the greatest purely vertical drop on Earth.
highlights:
Features a vertical cliff of 1,250 meters.
A bucket-list destination for base jumpers and big-wall climbers.
Located on Baffin Island in Nunavut.

name: Joffre Peak
overview: A prominent peak in the Joffre Group of the Coast Mountains, popular for winter climbing.
highlights:
Known for the 'Aussie Couloir' ski run.
Located near the popular Joffre Lakes Provincial Park.
Offers distinct steep faces of granite.

name: Mount Rainier
overview: A massive active stratovolcano and the highest mountain in the U.S. state of Washington.
highlights:
The most glaciated peak in the contiguous USA.
Dominates the Seattle skyline.
Considered one of the most dangerous volcanoes due to lahars.

name: Mount Whitney
overview: The highest mountain in the contiguous United States, located in the Sierra Nevada.
highlights:
Can be climbed via a non-technical trail (permit required).
The east face offers technical rock climbing.
Located just 85 miles from Badwater Basin, the lowest point in North America.

name: Mount Shasta
overview: A potentially active volcano at the southern end of the Cascade Range in California.
highlights:
Famous for its lenticular cloud formations.
A spiritual center for many Native American tribes and New Age groups.
Offers one of the longest continuous ski descents in the US.

name: Mount Hood
overview: A potentially active stratovolcano and the highest mountain in Oregon.
highlights:
Home to the only year-round ski lift in North America (Timberline).
One of the most climbed mountains in the world.
Iconic pyramidal shape visible from Portland.

name: Mount Jefferson
overview: A stratovolcano in the Cascade Range, the second highest peak in Oregon.
highlights:
Considered one of the hardest of the major Oregon volcanoes to climb.
Rugged and remote compared to Mount Hood.
Surrounded by scenic alpine meadows.

name: Mount Adams
overview: The second highest mountain in Washington State, a massive stratovolcano.
highlights:
Has a huge, flat summit ice cap.
Less crowded than Rainier but offers similar views.
Famous for the glissade (sliding on snow) descent.

name: Mount Baker
overview: An active glaciated andesitic stratovolcano in northern Washington.
highlights:
Holds the world record for snowfall in a single season (1,140 inches).
One of the snowiest places on Earth.
Visible from Vancouver, Canada.

name: Glacier Peak
overview: The most isolated of the five major stratovolcanoes in Washington.
highlights:
Requires a long trek just to reach the base.
Not visible from most major population centers.
A wilderness lover's favorite.

name: Mount St. Helens
overview: An active stratovolcano famous for its catastrophic 1980 eruption.
highlights:
Visitors can climb to the crater rim to see the lava dome.
The horseshoe-shaped crater is a stark reminder of volcanic power.
The surrounding landscape is a living laboratory of ecological recovery.

name: Grand Teton
overview: The highest point of the Teton Range in Wyoming, a classic destination for American mountaineering.
highlights:
Famous for its dramatic rise without foothills.
The 'Grand Teton' climb is a rite of passage.
Part of the iconic skyline viewed from Jackson Hole.

name: Pikes Peak
overview: The highest summit of the southern Front Range of the Rocky Mountains in Colorado.
highlights:
Famous for the Pikes Peak International Hill Climb auto race.
Accessible by car, cog railway, and hiking.
Inspired the song 'America the Beautiful'.

name: Longs Peak
overview: The highest peak in Rocky Mountain National Park, Colorado.
highlights:
The 'Keyhole Route' is a famous non-technical but exposed scramble.
Features the Diamond, a sheer vertical rock face.
One of Colorado's most coveted '14ers'.

name: Mount Elbert
overview: The highest summit of the Rocky Mountains of North America and the highest point in Colorado.
highlights:
Technically an easy 'walk-up' despite the altitude.
Offers massive views of the Sawatch Range.
The highest '14er' in the state.

name: Mount Massive
overview: The second highest summit of the Rocky Mountains, located near Mount Elbert.
highlights:
Has a massive, long summit ridge with five peaks over 14,000 ft.
Offers a more rugged experience than Elbert.
Named for its immense size and bulk.

name: Mount Mitchell
overview: The highest peak of the Appalachian Mountains and the highest peak in mainland eastern North America.
highlights:
Accessible by car via the Blue Ridge Parkway.
Home to a unique spruce-fir forest ecosystem.
Often shrouded in mist and fog.

name: Mount Washington
overview: The highest peak in the Northeastern United States, located in the White Mountains of New Hampshire.
highlights:
Notorious for having the 'world's worst weather'.
Held the record for the highest wind speed ever measured on Earth for decades.
Can be ascended by the Cog Railway or Auto Road.

name: Maroon Bells
overview: Two peaks (Maroon Peak and North Maroon Peak) in the Elk Mountains, known as the most photographed mountains in North America.
highlights:
Famous for their distinct maroon mudstone color.
Nicknamed the 'Deadly Bells' due to loose, rotting rock.
Reflected perfectly in Maroon Lake.

name: Mauna Kea
overview: A dormant volcano on the island of Hawaii. Measured from its base on the ocean floor, it is the tallest mountain in the world.
highlights:
Home to some of the world's most powerful astronomical observatories.
The summit is often covered in snow despite the tropical latitude.
Sacred to Native Hawaiians.

name: Mauna Loa
overview: One of five volcanoes that form the Island of Hawaii. It is the largest active volcano on Earth by mass and volume.
highlights:
A massive shield volcano with very gentle slopes.
Last erupted in 2022.
Make up more than half of the surface area of the Big Island.

name: Kilauea
overview: An active shield volcano in the Hawaiian Islands, and one of the most active volcanoes on Earth.
highlights:
Located in Hawaii Volcanoes National Park.
Features the Halemaʻumaʻu crater, legendary home of the goddess Pele.
Continuous eruptions often create new land.

name: Guadalupe Peak
overview: The highest natural point in Texas, located in Guadalupe Mountains National Park.
highlights:
Part of the ancient Capitan Reef limestone formation.
Offers views of the vast Chihuahuan Desert.
Known for the 'El Capitan' cliff nearby.

name: Pico de Orizaba
overview: A stratovolcano and the highest mountain in Mexico and the third highest in North America.
highlights:
Features the Jamapa Glacier, one of the few remaining in Mexico.
Active volcano, though currently dormant.
Visible from ships in the Gulf of Mexico.

name: Popocatepetl
overview: An active stratovolcano located near Mexico City. Its name means 'Smoking Mountain' in Nahuatl.
highlights:
One of Mexico's most active volcanoes, frequently spewing ash.
linked by legend to the nearby Iztaccihuatl volcano.
Climbing is often restricted due to volcanic activity.

name: Iztaccihuatl
overview: A dormant volcanic mountain known as the 'Sleeping Woman' because its profile resembles a reclining woman.
highlights:
The third highest mountain in Mexico.
A popular acclimatization climb for high-altitude mountaineers.
Features several distinct peaks representing the head, chest, and feet.

name: Aconcagua
overview: The highest mountain in the Americas, the Western Hemisphere, and the Southern Hemisphere.
highlights:
One of the 'Seven Summits'.
Non-technical 'Normal Route' makes it popular but altitude is dangerous.
Located in the Andes mountain range.

name: Ojos del Salado
overview: An active stratovolcano on the Chile-Argentina border. It is the highest volcano on Earth.
highlights:
Located near the Atacama Desert, so it is very dry.
Features a permanent crater lake, one of the highest in the world.
Accessible by 4x4 vehicles to a high altitude.

name: Monte Pissis
overview: An extinct volcano in the Argentine Andes, the third highest mountain in the Western Hemisphere.
highlights:
Located in a very remote part of the Atacama Desert high plateau.
Features massive glaciers despite the arid climate.
Named after a French geologist.

name: Mount Fitz Roy
overview: A mountain in Patagonia, on the border between Argentina and Chile. Known for its shark-tooth shape.
highlights:
One of the most technically challenging climbs in the world.
The silhouette is the logo for the Patagonia clothing brand.
Also known as Cerro Chaltén ('Smoking Mountain').

name: Cerro Torre
overview: A needle-like granite spire in Patagonia, famous for its extreme difficulty and controversial climbing history.
highlights:
Topped by a permanent mushroom of rime ice.
Considered by many to be the most beautiful mountain in the world.
Featured in the film 'Scream of Stone'.

name: Lanin
overview: A cone-shaped stratovolcano on the border of Argentina and Chile.
highlights:
Dominates the landscape of Lanín National Park.
A symbol of the province of Neuquén.
Popular for alpine climbing with crampons and ice axes.

name: Mount Tronador
overview: A geologically active extinct stratovolcano in the southern Andes. Its name means 'Thunderer' due to falling ice.
highlights:
Host to eight glaciers.
The highest peak in the Nahuel Huapi region.
Offers climbing routes from both Chilean and Argentine sides.

name: Torres del Paine
overview: A distinct mountain group in Patagonia featuring three massive granite towers.
highlights:
The centerpiece of Torres del Paine National Park.
The three needles (Monzino, Central, and Dagostini) are world-famous.
A premier trekking destination (the 'W' trek).

name: Huascaran
overview: The highest mountain in Peru and the fourth highest in South America, located in the Cordillera Blanca.
highlights:
Its summit is one of the places on Earth with the lowest gravitational pull.
Surrounded by tropical glaciers.
Can be climbed, but has objective hazards like avalanches.

name: Yerupaja
overview: The second highest mountain in Peru and the highest in the Cordillera Huayhuash.
highlights:
Known as 'The Butcher' due to its knife-edged ridges.
One of the hardest Andean peaks to climb.
Rarely visited compared to Huascaran.

name: Alpamayo
overview: A steep ice peak in the Cordillera Blanca, often voted the 'Most Beautiful Mountain in the World'.
highlights:
Famous for its perfect pyramidal shape of fluted ice.
The Southwest Face is a classic technical climb.
Featured on the logo of the Peruvian trekking police.

name: Siula Grande
overview: A mountain in the Huayhuash range, made famous by the survival story 'Touching the Void'.
highlights:
The harrowing story of Joe Simpson and Simon Yates happened here.
A formidable limestone and ice peak.
Notoriously difficult and dangerous to climb.

name: Chopicalqui
overview: A high peak in the Cordillera Blanca, often climbed as a 'easier' 6,000m peak compared to its neighbors.
highlights:
Provides one of the best views of Huascaran.
Features a spectacular summit mushroom ridge.
A classic step-up for high altitude mountaineers.

name: Misti
overview: A stratovolcano located near the city of Arequipa in southern Peru.
highlights:
Ideally symmetric cone shape.
Considered the symbol of Arequipa, built from its white volcanic stone (sillar).
Active volcano with fumarolic activity.

name: Vinicunca
overview: Also known as Rainbow Mountain or Montaña de Siete Colores.
highlights:
Famous for its multi-colored stripes of mineral deposits.
Became a major tourist attraction only recently due to melting snow.
High altitude trek required to reach the viewpoint.

name: Huayna Potosi
overview: A mountain near La Paz, Bolivia, popular as a 'beginner's' 6,000-meter peak.
highlights:
Very accessible from La Paz.
Offers incredible views of Lake Titicaca and the Altiplano.
A classic training ground for glacier travel.

name: Illimani
overview: The highest mountain in the Cordillera Real and the guardian symbol of La Paz.
highlights:
Dominates the skyline of the capital city.
Features four distinct summits.
Revered in local Aymara culture.

name: Sajama
overview: An extinct stratovolcano and the highest peak in Bolivia.
highlights:
Located in Sajama National Park.
Features the highest forest in the world (Queñua trees) on its slopes.
Isolated cone rising from the Altiplano.

name: Licancabur
overview: A highly symmetric stratovolcano on the Bolivia-Chile border, near the Atacama Desert.
highlights:
Overlooks the famous Laguna Verde.
The summit crater contains one of the highest lakes in the world.
Archeological sites found at the summit suggest Inca presence.

name: Cotopaxi
overview: An active stratovolcano in the Andes Mountains. It is one of the highest active volcanoes in the world.
highlights:
Famous for its almost perfect conical shape.
A very popular mountaineering objective in Ecuador.
Often visible from Quito on clear days.

name: Chimborazo
overview: A currently inactive stratovolcano. It is the highest mountain in Ecuador.
highlights:
Due to the equatorial bulge, its summit is the point on Earth closest to the sun.
Featured on the Ecuadorian coat of arms.
A massive, glaciated peak.

name: Tungurahua
overview: An active stratovolcano known as the 'Throat of Fire'.
highlights:
Has been erupting periodically since 1999.
Located near the tourist town of Baños.
Famous for its ash plumes and lava flows.

name: Mount Roraima
overview: The highest of the Pakaraima chain of tepui plateaus in South America.
highlights:
A flat-topped mountain surrounded by sheer cliffs.
Inspired Conan Doyle's 'The Lost World' and the movie 'Up'.
Features a unique ecosystem with endemic carnivorous plants.

name: Mount Erebus
overview: The second-highest volcano in Antarctica and the southernmost active volcano on Earth.
highlights:
Contains a persistent phonolitic lava lake.
Features ice fumaroles (ice towers emitting steam).
Located on Ross Island.

name: Puncak Jaya
overview: Also known as Carstensz Pyramid, it is the highest mountain in Indonesia and Oceania.
highlights:
One of the 'Seven Summits'.
A limestone peak rising from a dense tropical jungle.
Features one of the few equatorial glaciers, which are rapidly retreating.

name: Mount Kosciuszko
overview: The highest mountain on the Australian mainland, located in the Snowy Mountains.
highlights:
One of the easiest of the 'Seven Summits' (mainland version).
Accessible by a graded walking track.
Named after a Polish national hero.

name: Mount Cook
overview: The highest mountain in New Zealand. Its Maori name 'Aoraki' means 'Cloud Piercer'.
highlights:
Located in a Dark Sky Reserve, offering incredible stargazing.
A challenging technical climb with heavy glaciation.
Sir Edmund Hillary used it as a training ground for Everest.

name: Mount Aspiring
overview: Known as Tititea by the Maori, it is often called the 'Matterhorn of the South' due to its pyramidal peak.
highlights:
Located in Mount Aspiring National Park.
A classic mountaineering objective in New Zealand.
Surrounded by stunning glaciers and river valleys.

name: Mitre Peak
overview: An iconic mountain in Milford Sound, Fiordland National Park.
highlights:
One of the most photographed peaks in New Zealand.
Rises sheer from the waters of the fjord.
Resembles a bishop's mitre headwear.

name: Mount Tongariro
overview: A compound volcano in the Taupo Volcanic Zone. It is the oldest of the three volcanoes in the area.
highlights:
Famous for the Tongariro Alpine Crossing day hike.
Home to the Emerald Lakes and Blue Lake.
Filming location for Mordor in 'Lord of the Rings'.

name: Mount Taranaki
overview: A dormant stratovolcano in the Taranaki region, known for its near-perfect cone shape.
highlights:
Often used as a double for Mount Fuji in films (e.g., The Last Samurai).
Surrounded by a circular forest boundary.
Sacred to the local Maori people.

name: Mount Fuji
overview: An active stratovolcano and the highest mountain in Japan.
highlights:
Japan's most iconic landmark and a UNESCO World Heritage site.
Thousands climb it annually to watch the sunrise (Goraiko).
A sacred mountain in Shinto and Buddhism.

name: Mount Kita
overview: The second highest mountain in Japan and the highest of the Southern Alps.
highlights:
Part of Minami Alps National Park.
Features the Kitadake Buttress, a major rock climbing face.
Famous for its alpine plants and flowers.

name: Mount Yarigatake
overview: A mountain in the Northern Alps of Japan, known as the 'Matterhorn of Japan' for its spear-like shape.
highlights:
One of Japan's most popular hiking destinations.
The name means 'Spear Mountain'.
Offers challenging ridge lines and via ferrata sections.

name: Mount Aso
overview: The largest active volcano in Japan, and is among the largest in the world.
highlights:
Features a massive caldera with a circumference of over 100 km.
The Nakadake crater is accessible to tourists when active.
A landscape of steaming vents and volcanic ash.

name: Jade Mountain (Yushan)
overview: The highest mountain in Taiwan and Northeast Asia.
highlights:
The symbol of Taiwan, featured on banknotes.
Part of Yushan National Park.
Offers a diverse range of climate zones from subtropical to alpine.

name: Mount Kinabalu
overview: The highest mountain in Borneo and Malaysia.
highlights:
A UNESCO World Heritage site known for immense biodiversity.
Famous for its granite dome summit, Low's Peak.
Accessible climb requiring no technical skills, just stamina.

name: Fansipan
overview: The highest mountain in Vietnam and the Indochinese Peninsula, known as the 'Roof of Indochina'.
highlights:
Located in the Hoang Lien Son mountain range.
Accessible by a modern cable car or a multi-day trek.
Famous for its sea of clouds.

name: Mount Apo
overview: An active stratovolcano and the highest mountain in the Philippines.
highlights:
Grandfather of Philippine Mountains.
Home to the critically endangered Philippine Eagle.
Features crater lakes and steam vents.

name: Mayon Volcano
overview: An active stratovolcano in the province of Albay, renowned for its 'perfect cone' shape.
highlights:
Considered the world's most symmetrical volcanic cone.
Frequently active, with a history of destructive eruptions.
A major tourist attraction in the Bicol region.

name: Mount Pinatubo
overview: An active stratovolcano on the island of Luzon, famous for its cataclysmic 1991 eruption.
highlights:
The eruption created a stunning crater lake.
Popular for 4x4 trekking adventures.
The landscape is formed by lahar canyons.

name: Mount Semeru
overview: An active volcano in East Java. It is the highest mountain on the island of Java.
highlights:
Known as Mahameru (The Great Mountain).
Erupts regularly with small ash puffs.
Considered the father of Mount Agung in Bali.

name: Mount Agung
overview: An active volcano and the highest point on the island of Bali.
highlights:
The most sacred mountain for Balinese Hindus.
Home to the Besakih Temple on its slopes.
Climbed at night to witness sunrise over Lombok.

name: Mount Kerinci
overview: The highest volcano in Indonesia and the highest peak on the island of Sumatra.
highlights:
Located in Kerinci Seblat National Park, home to tigers and rhinos.
Offers views of the Indian Ocean from the summit.
A massive stratovolcano with a deep crater.

name: Mount Ijen
overview: A volcano complex in East Java known for its turquoise acidic crater lake.
highlights:
Famous for the 'blue fire' phenomenon caused by ignited sulfuric gas.
Site of traditional sulfur mining.
The crater lake is the world's largest highly acidic lake.

name: Mount Rinjani
overview: An active volcano on the island of Lombok, the second highest volcano in Indonesia.
highlights:
Features a massive caldera with a lake, Segara Anak.
A new volcano, Gunung Baru Jari, is growing inside the lake.
A major trekking destination.

name: Mount Bromo
overview: An active somma volcano and part of the Tengger massif in East Java.
highlights:
Famous for its moon-like landscape in the Sea of Sand.
One of the most visited tourist attractions in Indonesia.
Best viewed at sunrise from nearby Mount Penanjakan.

name: Mount Merapi
overview: The most active volcano in Indonesia, located near Yogyakarta.
highlights:
Its name means 'Mountain of Fire'.
Sacred in Javanese culture, believed to be a kingdom of spirits.
Regularly produces pyroclastic flows.

name: Krakatoa
overview: A volcanic island famous for its massive 1883 eruption. The current peak is Anak Krakatau (Child of Krakatoa).
highlights:
Located in the Sunda Strait between Java and Sumatra.
Anak Krakatau has been growing since the 1920s.
A symbol of the destructive power of nature.

name: Mount Damavand
overview: A potentially active stratovolcano and the highest peak in Iran and the Middle East.
highlights:
Central to Persian mythology and folklore.
A perfect cone shape visible from Tehran on clear days.
One of the Volcanic Seven Summits.

name: Jengish Chokusu
overview: The highest mountain in the Tian Shan mountain system. Formerly known as Peak Pobeda.
highlights:
Considered the most difficult and dangerous 7,000m peak to climb.
The northernmost 7,000-meter peak in the world.
Located on the Kyrgyzstan-China border.

name: Khan Tengri
overview: A mountain of the Tian Shan range. Its name means 'Lord of the Spirits' or 'Lord of the Sky'.
highlights:
Famous for its summit pyramid made of pink marble.
Beautifully symmetrical and often glows red at sunset.
The world's most northern 7,000-meter peak (with ice cap).

name: Ismoil Somoni Peak
overview: The highest mountain in Tajikistan and the former Soviet Union. Formerly known as Communism Peak.
highlights:
One of the five 'Snow Leopard' peaks.
A massive mountain in the Pamir range.
Renamed in 1998 to honor the ancestor of the Samanid dynasty.

name: Lenin Peak
overview: A mountain in the Trans-Alay Range. It is considered one of the easiest 7,000-meter peaks to climb.
highlights:
A very popular mountaineering destination.
Known for its straightforward non-technical route.
Site of a tragic mountaineering accident in 1990.

name: Belukha Mountain
overview: The highest peak of the Altai Mountains in Russia.
highlights:
Considered a sacred mountain, the 'Shambhala' of the Altai.
Features twin peaks.
Located near the borders of Russia, Kazakhstan, China, and Mongolia.

name: Muztagh Ata
overview: The second highest of the mountains which form the northern edge of the Tibetan Plateau. Name means 'Father of Ice Mountains'.
highlights:
Popular for ski mountaineering due to its gentle slopes.
One of the easiest 7,500m peaks to climb.
Located along the Karakoram Highway.

name: Machapuchare
overview: A mountain in the Annapurna Himalayas of north central Nepal. Known as the 'Fishtail' due to its double summit.
highlights:
Revered by the local population as sacred to Lord Shiva.
Officially unclimbed, as permits are not issued.
One of the most photogenic mountains in Nepal.

name: Ama Dablam
overview: A mountain in the eastern Himalayas of Nepal. The name means 'Mother's Necklace'.
highlights:
Considered one of the most beautiful mountains in the world.
Featured on the Rupee banknote of Nepal.
A popular expedition peak for technical climbers.

name: Nuptse
overview: A mountain in the Khumbu region of the Mahalangur Himal, two kilometers WSW of Mount Everest.
highlights:
Part of the Everest massif (Everest-Lhotse-Nuptse).
The name means 'West Peak' in Tibetan.
Known for its long, jagged ridge.

name: Pumori
overview: A mountain on the Nepal-China border. The name translates to 'Unmarried Daughter' in the Sherpa language.
highlights:
A popular training peak for Everest.
Known as 'Everest's Daughter'.
Offers a classic view of Everest's Khumbu Icefall.

name: Gangkhar Puensum
overview: The highest mountain in Bhutan and the highest unclimbed mountain in the world.
highlights:
Climbing is currently prohibited due to spiritual beliefs.
Located on the border with China (disputed).
A candidate for the highest point on Earth never reached by man.

name: Mount Gongga
overview: Also known as Minya Konka, it is the highest mountain in Sichuan province.
highlights:
The easternmost 7,000-meter peak in the world.
Notorious for its difficulty and high fatality rate.
Sacred in Tibetan Buddhism.

name: Mount Siguniang
overview: The 'Four Girls Mountain' in Sichuan, consisting of four adjacent peaks.
highlights:
The highest peak, Yaomei (Youngest Sister), is the queen of Sichuan's peaks.
Often called the 'Alps of the East'.
Popular for both trekking and technical climbing.

name: Kawagarbo
overview: The highest peak of the Meili Snow Mountains in Yunnan province.
highlights:
One of the most sacred mountains in Tibetan Buddhism.
Climbing was banned in 2001 due to cultural respect and danger.
Site of a major mountaineering tragedy in 1991.

name: Namcha Barwa
overview: A mountain in the Tibetan Himalaya. It is the eastern anchor of the entire Himalayan chain.
highlights:
The Yarlung Tsangpo Great Bend wraps around it.
Known for its dramatic vertical relief.
Only climbed once, in 1992.

name: Mount Kailash
overview: A peak in the Kailash Range (Gangdise Mountains), considered sacred in four religions: Bon, Buddhism, Hinduism, and Jainism.
highlights:
It is forbidden to climb the mountain.
Pilgrims perform a 'kora' (circumambulation) around the base.
Believed to be the axis mundi, center of the world.

name: Mount Tai
overview: A mountain of historical and cultural significance in Shandong province. It is the foremost of the Five Great Mountains of China.

A UNESCO World Heritage site.
Associated with sunrise, birth, and renewal.
Features thousands of stone steps and ancient inscriptions.

name: Huangshan
overview: Yellow Mountain in Anhui province, famous for its scenery, sunsets, and peculiarly shaped granite peaks.

A frequent subject of traditional Chinese painting and literature.
Known for its 'Sea of Clouds' and twisted pine trees.
A UNESCO World Heritage Site.

Famous for the dangerous 'Plank Walk in the Sky'.
Features five main peaks with steep cliffs.
A major Taoist center.

name: Mount Emei
overview: One of the Four Sacred Buddhist Mountains of China, located in Sichuan province.
highlights:
Site of the first Buddhist temple in China.
Famous for its 'Golden Summit' and sea of clouds.
Home to wild Tibetan macaques.

Considered the spiritual home of the Korean people.
Features a massive crater lake called Heaven Lake (Chonji).
Also known as Changbaishan in China.

name: Jirisan
overview: The second-tallest mountain in South Korea and the tallest on the mainland.

South Korea's first National Park.
Home to the Asiatic black bear conservation program.
Features ancient temples like Hwaeomsa.

name: Seoraksan
overview: The highest mountain in the Taebaek mountain range in Gangwon Province, South Korea.

Famous for its jagged granite peaks and autumn foliage.
Features the giant bronze Buddha at Sinheungsa temple.
Known for Ulsanbawi Rock.

overview: A shield volcano on Jeju Island and the highest mountain in South Korea.
highlights:
A UNESCO World Natural Heritage site.
Features a crater lake called Baengnokdam.
Home to a unique vertical ecosystem.

name: Kumgangsan
overview: The 'Diamond Mountain' of North Korea, famed for its scenic beauty.

Subject of numerous Korean artistic works.
Previously accessible to South Korean tourists (suspended).
Known for its 12,000 needles of granite.

Famous for the 'sacred footprint' rock formation near the summit.

highlights:
Ferry rides between Buenos Aires and Montevideo.
Enjoying the riverfront Puerto Madero district.
Windsurfing and sailing on the wide waters.

name: Murray River
overview: The Murray River is Australia's longest river. It forms the border between New South Wales and Victoria and is a popular destination for houseboating and water sports.
highlights:
Houseboat holidays near Mildura or Echuca.
Paddle-steamer cruises.
Wine tasting in the riverland regions.

name: Darling River
overview: The Darling River is the third-longest river in Australia and a major tributary of the Murray River. It flows through the stark and beautiful landscapes of the Outback.
highlights:
Exploring the historic port town of Bourke.
Birdwatching in the Menindee Lakes.
Experiencing the rugged Australian bush.

name: Volga River
overview: The Volga is the longest river in Europe and is widely viewed as the national river of Russia. It flows through major cities like Volgograd, Kazan, and Nizhny Novgorod.
highlights:
River cruises from Moscow to St. Petersburg (via canals).
Viewing the Motherland Calls statue in Volgograd.
Seeing the Kazan Kremlin overlooking the river.

name: Euphrates River
overview: The Euphrates is the longest and one of the most historically important rivers of Western Asia. Along with the Tigris, it defines the land of Mesopotamia.
highlights:
Visiting ancient archaeological sites like Babylon.
Seeing the expansive Atatürk Dam in Turkey.
Exploring the marshes of Southern Iraq.

name: Yukon River
overview: The Yukon River is a major watercourse of northwestern North America. It was the principal route for the Klondike Gold Rush and remains a symbol of the wild north.
highlights:
Canoeing the classic route from Whitehorse to Dawson City.
Visiting Klondike Gold Rush historic sites.
Viewing the Five Finger Rapids.

name: Indus River
overview: The Indus River is one of the longest rivers in Asia, originating in the Tibetan Plateau and flowing through Pakistan to the Arabian Sea. It sustained the ancient Indus Valley Civilization.
highlights:
Visiting the ruins of Mohenjo-daro.
Seeing the blind Indus river dolphin.
Exploring the scenic gorges in the Ladakh region.

name: Sao Francisco River
overview: The São Francisco River is the longest river that runs entirely within Brazil. Known as the 'River of National Integration,' it connects the distinct climatic regions of the country.
highlights:
Boat tours through the Xingó Canyon.
Visiting the historic town of Penedo.
Seeing the Paulo Afonso Falls.

name: Syr Darya River
overview: The Syr Darya is a river in Central Asia that flows into the Aral Sea basin. It was historically known as the Jaxartes and marked the northern limit of Alexander the Great's conquests.
highlights:
Exploring the historic city of Khujand.
Viewing the remnants of fortresses along the Silk Road.
Observing the river's path through the steppe.

name: Salween River
overview: The Salween flows from the Tibetan Plateau into the Andaman Sea. It remains one of the longest free-flowing rivers in the world, passing through deep gorges and diverse ethnic regions.
highlights:
Visiting the Hpa-An region with its limestone karsts.
Seeing the Three Parallel Rivers UNESCO site in China.
Experiencing local culture in Mawlamyine.

name: St. Lawrence River
overview: The St. Lawrence River connects the Great Lakes to the Atlantic Ocean. It is a vital commercial waterway and flows past major cities like Montreal and Québec City.
highlights:
Whale watching near Tadoussac.
Touring the Thousand Islands region.
Viewing the historic fortifications of Québec City.

name: Rio Grande
overview: The Rio Grande (known as Rio Bravo in Mexico) forms a natural border between the United States and Mexico. It flows from Colorado to the Gulf of Mexico.
highlights:
Rafting in Big Bend National Park.
Exploring the scenic Santa Elena Canyon.
Visiting historic missions in the river valley.

name: Brahmaputra River
overview: The Brahmaputra is a major trans-boundary river in Asia. It is known for its massive width in parts of Assam and its deep gorges in the Himalayas.
highlights:
River cruises in Assam to see Kaziranga National Park.
Visiting the river island of Majuli.
Seeing the Umananda Temple on Peacock Island.

name: Danube River
overview: The Danube is Europe's second-longest river, flowing through ten countries. It has been a vital trade route and cultural connector for centuries, linking Vienna, Budapest, and Belgrade.
highlights:
Evening cruises past the Hungarian Parliament in Budapest.
Cycling along the river in the Wachau Valley.
Visiting the Iron Gates gorge.

name: Tocantins River
overview: The Tocantins River is a major river in Brazil. While often considered a tributary of the Amazon, it technically flows into the Atlantic Ocean alongside the Amazon Delta.
highlights:
Visiting the Tucuruí Dam.
Fishing and eco-tourism in the basin.
Seeing the meeting of waters near Belém.

name: Zambezi River
overview: The Zambezi is the fourth-longest river in Africa. It is most famous for Victoria Falls, one of the Seven Natural Wonders of the World, located on the border of Zambia and Zimbabwe.
highlights:
Viewing the spectacular Victoria Falls.
White water rafting in the Batoka Gorge.
Sunset cruises and wildlife spotting (hippos, elephants).

name: Araguaia River
overview: The Araguaia River is a major Brazilian river. It forms the Bananal Island, the largest river island in the world, known for its rich biodiversity.
highlights:
Relaxing on seasonal freshwater river beaches.
Eco-tourism on Bananal Island.
Sport fishing and bird watching.

name: Amu Darya River
overview: The Amu Darya is a major river in Central Asia, historically known as the Oxus. It forms part of the border between Afghanistan and its northern neighbors.
highlights:
Exploring the ancient fortresses of Khorezm.
Visiting the historic city of Termez.
Seeing the river's delta near the vanishing Aral Sea.

name: Nelson River
overview: The Nelson River drains Lake Winnipeg into Hudson Bay. It is a massive river used heavily for hydroelectric power generation in Manitoba.
highlights:
Viewing the rugged Canadian Shield landscape.
Fishing for northern pike and walleye.
History of the fur trade routes.

name: Saskatchewan River
overview: The Saskatchewan River is a major river in Canada, flowing east across the prairies. Its name comes from the Cree word for 'swift flowing river'.
highlights:
Visiting The Pas and the river delta.
Canoeing through the boreal forest.
Birdwatching in the expansive marshes.

name: Paraguay River
overview: The Paraguay River flows through the Pantanal wetlands before joining the Paraná River. It serves as a crucial corridor for trade and nature in landlocked Paraguay.
highlights:
Wildlife safaris in the Pantanal wetlands.
Boat trips from Asunción.
Fishing for Piranha and Pacu.

name: Kolyma River
overview: The Kolyma River is located in northeastern Siberia. The region is historically infamous for Gulag camps but is also known for its stark, frozen beauty.
highlights:
Extreme adventure tourism in the Magadan region.
Visiting the Jack London Lake nearby.
Experiencing the remote tundra environment.

name: Ganges River
overview: The Ganges (Ganga) is the most sacred river to Hindus and a lifeline to millions in India. It flows from the Himalayas to the Bay of Bengal.
highlights:
Witnessing the Ganga Aarti ceremony in Varanasi.
River rafting in Rishikesh.
Boat rides at sunrise to see the ghats.

name: Pilcomayo River
overview: The Pilcomayo River is a tributary of the Paraguay River. Its basin is shared by Bolivia, Argentina, and Paraguay, often suffering from sediment buildup.
highlights:
Exploring the Pilcomayo National Park.
Observing caimans and diverse bird species.
Experiencing the Gran Chaco ecosystem.

name: Ural River
overview: The Ural River flows from the Ural Mountains to the Caspian Sea. Conventionally, it is considered the boundary between the continents of Europe and Asia.
highlights:
Standing on the pedestrian bridge in Orenburg (Europe-Asia border).
Fishing for sturgeon (though strictly regulated).
Visiting the city of Atyrau near the delta.

name: Arkansas River
overview: The Arkansas River is a major tributary of the Mississippi River. It flows through the Great Plains and the US South, offering diverse landscapes from mountains to delta.
highlights:
White water rafting through the Royal Gorge in Colorado.
Walking the River Trail in Little Rock.
Fishing for trout in the tailwaters.

name: Dnieper River
overview: The Dnieper is one of the major rivers of Europe, flowing south through Russia, Belarus, and Ukraine to the Black Sea. It is central to Ukrainian history and geography.
highlights:
River cruises in Kyiv with views of the Lavra.
Visiting Khortytsia Island, the historic home of the Cossacks.
Relaxing on the city beaches in summer.

name: Colorado River
overview: The Colorado River is famous for carving the Grand Canyon. It is a critical water source for the arid southwestern United States and supports significant recreation.
highlights:
Rafting the Grand Canyon rapids.
Visiting Horseshoe Bend.
Seeing the Hoover Dam and Lake Mead.

name: Irrawaddy River
overview: The Irrawaddy River is the country's largest river and most important commercial waterway. It connects the north to the Andaman Sea, passing historic Bagan.
highlights:
Cruising between Mandalay and Bagan.
Spotting the endangered Irrawaddy dolphin.
Viewing ancient pagodas from the water.

name: Xi River
overview: The Xi River is the western tributary of the Pearl River in southern China. It is a major commercial artery for the region leading to the South China Sea.
highlights:
Cruising the scenic river landscapes near Wuzhou.
Exploring the vibrant Pearl River Delta region.
Visiting the Seven Star Crags.

name: Ohio River
overview: The Ohio River is the largest tributary of the Mississippi River by volume. It flows from Pittsburgh to Cairo, Illinois, serving as a boundary for several US states.
highlights:
Riverboat festivals in Cincinnati and Louisville.
Walking across the Roebling Suspension Bridge.
Visiting Point State Park in Pittsburgh.

name: Allegheny River
overview: The Allegheny River joins with the Monongahela River in Pittsburgh to form the Ohio River. It flows through the scenic hills of Pennsylvania.
highlights:
Kayaking near the Kinzua Dam.
